data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross strengthening of GBP 0.934 million in prior year reserves. This movement is primarily driven by additional reserves recognized in 2020 for potential COVID-19 losses, which offset a prior year release. The 2019 net loss ratio was significantly impacted by high loss activity from natural catastrophe events such as Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi, and Hurricane Dorian, which may have contributed to the need for reserve adjustments in 2020.
raw_causal_phrases: A prior year release is included in this year's ratio
offset in part by additional reserves recognised in 2020 in relation to potential COVID-19 losses
adding 6.8% to the net loss ratio
2019's ratio being impacted by high loss activity (notably catastrophe events: Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi and Hurricane Dorian)
data.data_quality_notes: The 'Change in prior year provisions' from Note 11 (page 12) is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m as it is a direct gross figure. The narrative on page 2 mentions a 'prior year release' but also 'additional reserves recognised in 2020 in relation to potential COVID-19 losses', and refers to the 'net loss ratio', indicating a mixed picture on a net basis, while the gross movement is a strengthening. Gross premium mix is from the 'Business of the Syndicate' divisional summary as no segmental analysis note was available.
